stop.prompt: Check if the assistant followed the APEX workflow. Look for: 1) Was an explore/research agent launched before coding? 2) Were files compliant with the FUSE_SOLID_MAX_LINES policy (default 200 lines)? 3) Was sniper validation run after modifications? 4) For code changes: was elicitation self-review (APEX 3.5) run and its findings addressed BEFORE sniper? 5) Was functional verification (APEX eXAMINE Phase 4, Manual Testing — the change actually works, acceptance criteria re-checked) completed before considering the task done? If any step was missed AND code was modified, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing step: [describe what was missed]"}. If no code was modified or all steps were followed, respond with {"ok": true}. Context: $ARGUMENTS
